args.message: Flame impala has the highest gross margin per unit sold: $10.57, which is 0.755 of its price. It sells for $14.00 and its supplies cost $3.43 per unit. I worked out the margin as the list price minus the total cost of the product's supply components. Prices and costs are stored in cents, so I converted them to dollars. The next highest is "nutellaphone who dis?" at $9.79 (0.89 of its price).
